adminDashboards.name: the-surveyed-field
adminDashboards.note: The most honest object in the set — it refuses to draw a mark for an unheld request. But it ships a KEY LEGEND of four mark types and three ring types: the visitor must learn a notation before acting, which is the client's literal stated breaking condition (brief §6).

systemicFindings: ROOT CAUSE FOUND: `.claude/agents/ui-designer.md` grants `tools: Read, Write, Bash, Grep, Glob` — NO Edit. Every other authoring agent has it. A designer iterating on a 50KB HTML file must re-emit the whole file to fix three lines, which exhausts maxTurns:30. Six agents in this wave were cut off DURING or just before applying fixes they had already correctly diagnosed. The single agent that finished comfortably in wave 1 was the one that never iterated — and it scored 3. The tool grant selects against the behaviour that produces quality.

STALE-RENDER HAZARD: a craft grade is only valid against the PNG that was rendered from the CURRENT file. One landing was graded against a superseded render and its verdict was wrong. Re-render immediately before grading, and compare mtimes.

RESOLUTION LIMIT: full-page 1440px renders reach a vision judge ~4x downsampled, which is below the resolution needed to confirm a 1px hairline lying on a glyph. The judge stated this honestly rather than guessing. Settle stroke-over-text questions with a geometric DOM check plus 2x crops, not with a full-page screenshot.

MAKING A CONSTRAINT INTO THE CONCEPT MAXIMISES ITS SURFACE AREA: the-surveyed-field was authored so that 'every ring breaks around any word' WAS the governing idea, and it failed that rule harder than any other direction. A territory with no arcs cannot misplace one.
